title: Pulsar - Innatera neuromorphic microcontroller
summary: Innatera's Pulsar is a commercially available brain-inspired microcontroller combining an Spiking Neural Network (SNN) engine with RISC-V and CNN acceleration. Designed for edge devices, it processes event-driven sensor data at microwatt power levels without cloud dependency. The architecture supports wearables, IoT, and industrial applications like predictive maintenance via the Talamo SDK.
tldr: Innatera's Pulsar is a commercially available neuromorphic microcontroller integrating SNN engines with RISC-V for ultra-low-power edge intelligence in wearables and IoT devices.
